title: Unit 4: Ethnic Groups of Viet Nam

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Customs and costumes of Vietnamese ethnic groups
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Customs and costumes of Vietnamese ethnic groups.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.term: The Definite Article 'The' with Ethnic Groups
concepts.definition: Use 'The' before the name of an ethnic group or nationality to refer to the entire people: The Kinh, the Thai, the H'mong, the Tay.
concepts.example: The Tay people have their own written language and rich folklore.
concepts.essence: 'The' pluralizes and unifies the collective identity of the community.

rules.statement: Zero article before plural countable nouns in general statements
rules.meaning: Do not use 'the' when talking about things or people in general.
rules.example: Terraced fields are common in mountainous areas. (General statement -> No article)
rules.essence: Using 'the' specifies a particular set of fields already known to the speaker.

workedExamples.prompt: Fill in the blank with 'a', 'an', 'the' or zero article: '__________ communal house is __________ heart of the village in the Central Highlands.'
steps: Step 1: First blank refers to a typical communal house in general: 'A communal house' or specific 'The communal house'.
Step 2: Second blank refers to a unique metaphorical centre: 'the heart of...'
Step 3: 'The communal house is the heart of the village in the Central Highlands.'

commonMistakes.mistake: Omitting 'the' when referring to ethnic groups: 'Kinh people' instead of 'The Kinh people'.
commonMistakes.why: In formal English, the definite article 'the' is mandatory when designating an entire ethnic group.
